messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
People around you are stressed: Tom Bradley. The mood is tense.

Rachel Green executed on the full slate she committed to at tick 11. She submitted three tailored job applications — one to Millfield Regional Health Systems' communications team, one to a financial services firm in the adjacent market, and one to a regional logistics company expanding through the disruption. She sent her final close message to Nicole Washington: professional, specific, no softening. Nicole responded the same evening — not a yes, but not a no: 'Can we talk next week? I think I want to move forward but I need to look at my budget.' Rachel has the Angela Wright referral call on record; Angela confirmed she regularly encounters small business owners who need communications support and agreed to refer, though no concrete client has materialized yet. The LinkedIn piece went up and got strong engagement from her existing network. Four months of runway remain, the pipeline is active and real, but no revenue has closed — the gap between preparation and income is still the central tension.
